title: Clean-Schedule Points, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installment Late Charge
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — contracts whose schedule has never been changed.**

**Rule.** When the contract's ledger shows no extension and no due-date change, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the unpaid installment rate; when it shows no extension but at least one due-date change, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The ledger is read over the whole life of the contract: an extension entry or a due-date change entry of any date counts. The points come off the unpaid installment rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the unpaid installment portion.

| Extension entries | Due-date change entries | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 0.5 |
| none | one or more | 0.25 |
| one or more | any | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a contract that moved its due date once and was never extended takes 0.25 points off; a contract extended once and never moved takes none.
